title: Job fails at setup with 'automatically failed because it uses a deprecated version of actions/upload-artifact: v3'
symptoms: Error: This request has been automatically failed because it uses a deprecated version of `actions/upload-artifact: v3`.
No workflow file references v3, yet the job fails
GitHub Pages deploys fail through an old upload-pages-artifact version
cause: v1, v2, and v3 of the artifact actions are retired on github.com, and composite actions such as older upload-pages-artifact releases still call v3 internally.
fix: Move every artifact action, and actions that wrap them, to current majors.
apply:
- uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
- uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
- uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
affected: actions/upload-artifact and download-artifact v1 to v3 on github.com (v3 deprecation from 2024-11-30); GHES still uses v3
